title: Warm Quick Mediterranean Penne Pasta
description: A quick and easy Mediterranean penne pasta dish featuring fresh vegetables and a light sauce, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This dish is jain-friendly and can be prepared in under 30 minutes.

ingredients.name: penne rigate
ingredients.notes: whole wheat penne rigate for a nutty flavor

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne rigate according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the sliced cucumber until tender.
Add the halved cherry tomatoes, pitted kalamata olives, and chopped artichoke hearts to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for 1 minute.
Drain the cooked penne rigate and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the vegetables and sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Garnish with additional parsley and lemon wedges if desired.
